why: Need for cognition is examined as a domain-general facilitator of the canonical Four-Phase Model of Interest Development, while the article does not establish a distinct theory or identify phase-specific mechanisms.

why: The NFC-Teens scale is a named self-report assessment instrument for measuring adolescents' need for cognition, not a reusable instructional element.
name: NFC-Teens scale (11 positively worded items)
product_description: A German-adapted, 11-item positively worded Likert self-report scale developed from Cacioppo and Petty's need-for-cognition measure to assess adolescents' tendency to engage in and enjoy effortful cognitive activity.
